selected_records.title: UltraLight Luma: A Novel Edge-Deployable Perception Network for Crop-Row Segmentation in Agricultural Robotics

article.body:
UltraLight Luma paper offers no verified robot-trial details

An arXiv record describes UltraLight Luma as an edge-deployable perception network for crop-row segmentation in agricultural robotics. The available record provides no paper text or supporting evidence, so it does not establish a robot embodiment, segmentation results, training method, autonomy level or test environment. No claim about operation in a field or other real-world setting can be verified.
